summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by TJGC Group Limited reporting the results of an adjourned extraordinary general meeting held on August 7, 2026. Shareholders approved resolutions to (a) change the authorized share composition to add Class A and Class B ordinary shares, and (b) re-designate existing issued ordinary shares into Class A and Class B ordinary shares. Approved matters also included adopting amended articles of association and related actions. No special-situation event (e.g., acquisition, tender offer, restructuring) is involved; this is a routine corporate governance matter. The filing is informational for a foreign private issuer.
